summary.en: The Detective Boys and Conan met a group called the Silver Detective League, who are similar to them. The Silver Detective League said that they saw a thief with blond hair and followed him into a house, where they saw Kiyomasa Kuroda's corpse. Location: Kuroda's house Victim: Kiyomasa Kuroda Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Unknown culprit The Silver Detective League then seemed to have solved the case and said the blond thief killed Kiyomasa, but Conan is doubting whether that is the truth.
